title: Irish Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with lamb, potatoes, carrots, and onions. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot, and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix together the semolina flour and beef broth until smooth.
Add the flour-broth mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
